analysis_dashboard.optimize_resume: Optimize your resume for applicant tracking systems (ATS) and align your skills with your dream job in seconds.
analysis_dashboard.smart_parsing_desc: Our advanced NLP engine scans your uploaded resume to extract key sections, technical proficiencies, and experience.
analysis_dashboard.keyword_alignment_des: We match your profile against the target job description to identify essential missing skills and keywords required by employers.
analysis_dashboard.actionable_insights_d: Get personalized recommendations, tailored courses, and resume writing tips to instantly boost your interview chances.
analysis_dashboard.beat_ats_desc: Achieve a high efficiency score to ensure your resume passes automated screening tools and reaches human recruiters.
analysis_dashboard.tip1: Use exact keyword matches from the job description for core skills.
analysis_dashboard.tip2: Avoid complex tables, graphics, or multi-column layouts.
analysis_dashboard.tip3: Quantify your achievements with clear metrics and percentages.
analysis_dashboard.tip4: Use standard section headings like 'Experience' and 'Education'.
